blocks.x: Sense everything that matters — retrofit-friendly sensor fabric with governed telemetry. That is the contract Industrial IoT & Sensor Fabric signs. Below: what we build, in what order, and what your team holds at every gate.

Brownfield plants cannot gut-and-replace; sensor fabric must retrofit. We engineer the sensing layer for real environments: environment-rated devices (IP-rated, Ex-certified where needed), retrofit mounting on existing assets, protocol translation from fieldbuses (Modbus, PROFINET, CAN) and raw sensors into OPC UA / MQTT Sparkplug B, and a governed telemetry pipeline with device registry, provisioning and OTA updates. Power and connectivity constraints get engineered answers: LoRaWAN/NB-IoT for wide-area, private 5G for dense mobile, edge gateways aggregating at the line.

The governance layer is what separates a sensor deployment from a sensor fabric: device lifecycle ownership, data contracts per signal, calibration schedules, and quality gates on ingestion. Clients get telemetry they can build twins, models and control loops on — because the timestamps are trustworthy, the units are consistent and the lineage is known.

The sectors where Industrial IoT & Sensor Fabric currently runs: Manufacturing & Industrial, Energy & Utilities, Logistics & Supply Chain, Agriculture & Food Systems. Each engagement anchors to one named metric in that sector's own language.
